crossIssueCollaborationUxLab.heading: Open cross-task collaboration — attribution, audit, and denial copy
crossIssueCollaborationUxLab.intro: Agents may now write to any task they can read. These are the three surfaces that keep that legible: whose authority a comment rode, what an edit changed, and — when a write is refused — which boundary fired and what to do instead.
crossIssueCollaborationUxLab.s1CrossBody: Dotta asked me to flag that the retry window here overlaps TASK-482. Worth a look before you close this.
crossIssueCollaborationUxLab.s1Description: An agent commenting on a task it is not assigned to names the responsible user whose authority it rode. The assignee's own comments stay unchipped — that is the ordinary case, and chipping every bubble would be noise.
crossIssueCollaborationUxLab.s1LongBody: The chip caps its width and truncates; the tooltip carries the full name.
crossIssueCollaborationUxLab.s1LongLabel: Long user name truncates in the chip
crossIssueCollaborationUxLab.s1MissingBody: Falls back to a generic label rather than printing a raw user id.
crossIssueCollaborationUxLab.s1MissingLabel: Responsible user not in the loaded directory
crossIssueCollaborationUxLab.s1OwnBody: Rebased onto master and re-ran the containment suite; all green.
crossIssueCollaborationUxLab.s1Title: “Fable · for Dotta” on a cross-task agent comment
crossIssueCollaborationUxLab.s2AgentVerb: changed the status from todo to in progress
crossIssueCollaborationUxLab.s2BoardLabel: Board (human) edit — audited the same way
crossIssueCollaborationUxLab.s2Description: Required for agent and board edits alike. Before/after per field, the responsible user behind the write, and the authorization reason that let it through.
crossIssueCollaborationUxLab.s2MultiLabel: Reassignment, blockers, and work mode in one write
crossIssueCollaborationUxLab.s2OlderLabel: Older activity row — no receipt, renders unchanged
crossIssueCollaborationUxLab.s2Title: Every PATCH says who changed what, and under which authorization
crossIssueCollaborationUxLab.s3BeforeError: 403 Forbidden: Issue is outside this actor's authorization boundary
crossIssueCollaborationUxLab.s3BeforeLabel: Before — what the incident actually saw
crossIssueCollaborationUxLab.s3BeforeText: No boundary named, nobody named, no path forward. The workaround (create a child issue) had to be discovered by trial and error.
crossIssueCollaborationUxLab.s3Description: A real incident burned a full detour discovering a workaround behind an opaque 403. These are all the ways an issue write can now be refused — the same copy the API error body carries.
crossIssueCollaborationUxLab.s3Title: Every wall names the boundary, who can act, and the sanctioned path

designGuide.sidebarNavNote: Layout accepts sidebarSections to compose additional SidebarSection groups inside the shared sidebar. Use SidebarNavItem for each row, with sibling action buttons for starring or menus. The Chats section shows starred agents, the earliest-created agent when unstarred, then four recent agents without duplicates. Compose and star controls share a vertical column. Compose appears on hover or keyboard focus and remains visible on touch; starred icons remain visible. The picker searches all company agents by name or role without a subtitle, count, continuation labels, or footer. Task breadcrumbs support leading identity and trailing actions beside the label, including single-item task headers; see the Agent chat Storybook.
designGuide.skillSourcesNote: The shared FileTree explorer layout puts disclosure controls beside selection, with compact folder chains, equal-height rows, inline skill descriptions, and trailing status badges. Folders select descendant packages; package checkboxes select only that package, independently of nested skills. Included files use aligned rows without individual checkboxes (`getCheckboxState` returns null); package rows use `renderNodeExtra` for file counts and inspection. Use arrow keys to navigate and Space to select.

instanceExperimentalSettings.agentChatDesc: Talk to each agent in one ongoing conversation. Clarify goals and create tasks for execution. Chat leads the Work group and opens an agent rail beside the nav, and each chat's side panel shows the agent's tasks and artifacts as cards.

instanceExperimentalSettings.assistantDesc: Connect Codex, Claude, and other assistants to your Paperclip organization. People sign in, select an organization once, and approve access to review work, delegate tasks, and add feedback.
instanceExperimentalSettings.assistantFootnote: Requires an authenticated instance with a configured public URL. Takes effect immediately. Turning this off blocks assistant calls and event delivery; work already delegated continues.
instanceExperimentalSettings.autoRestartDesc: In `pnpm dev:once`, wait for all queued and running local agent runs to finish, then restart the server automatically when backend changes or migrations make the current boot stale.
instanceExperimentalSettings.betaSkillsDesc: Allow agents to pin beta releases of the Paperclip core skill. Disabling this returns every agent to the default live skill without removing saved pins.
instanceExperimentalSettings.builtInDesc: Show Paperclip-managed built-in agent surfaces, including built-in roster badges, the Built-in agents tab, and built-in agent setup controls.
instanceExperimentalSettings.casesDesc: Durable work products (blog posts, tweet storms…) that tasks create and iterate on. Adds the Cases tab and the agent case API.
instanceExperimentalSettings.casesFootnote: Turning Cases off hides the tab and blocks the case API; existing case data is kept.
instanceExperimentalSettings.chatConnectorsDesc: Connect agents to Slack, Discord, Microsoft Teams, and Telegram conversations.
instanceExperimentalSettings.chatConnectorsFootnote: Turning this off hides experimental chat setup and connected-task controls. Existing chat connections keep running. AgentMail, GitHub review bots, and tool connectors are controlled separately.
instanceExperimentalSettings.classicAria: Toggle classic task interface experimental setting
instanceExperimentalSettings.classicDesc: Restores the previous task detail page: the page-level header with inline description editing, the plain comment thread, and the fixed Properties sidebar. Chat-only features — streaming activity folding, inline plan and question cards, the three-mode composer — are unavailable in the classic view.
instanceExperimentalSettings.classicFootnote: Switching takes effect immediately. No task data is affected.
instanceExperimentalSettings.combinedAria: Toggle combined inbox and task list experimental setting
instanceExperimentalSettings.combinedDesc: Fold Inbox into Tasks. One Tasks row carries the unread badge, and a Views menu reaches every inbox view (Mine, Unread, Blocked, Recent, Everything) and every task view.
instanceExperimentalSettings.combinedFootnote: Old Inbox links redirect to the matching view. Turning this off restores the separate Inbox; no data changes.
instanceExperimentalSettings.conferenceAria: Toggle conference room chat experimental setting
instanceExperimentalSettings.conferenceDesc: Adds a Conference Room — one chat where you and your whole team work together — plus the live activity feed and the redesigned onboarding. Also restyles task threads as chat bubbles. Turn off anytime to restore the classic UI.
instanceExperimentalSettings.decisionsDesc: Show the Decisions item in the main sidebar — the attention home that surfaces the tasks awaiting your input — while the surface is still being evaluated.
instanceExperimentalSettings.devModeAria: Toggle Paperclip developer mode experimental setting
instanceExperimentalSettings.devModeDesc: Show internal Paperclip maintainer tools and observability links, including Honeycomb trace queries on run pages.
instanceExperimentalSettings.environmentsDesc: Show environment management in company settings and allow project and agent environment assignment controls.
instanceExperimentalSettings.externalDesc: Detect external URLs in issues and show resolved status for pull requests, tickets, and other referenced work objects.
instanceExperimentalSettings.fastDesc: Show Connections in company settings and allow short acknowledgements while agents begin work.
instanceExperimentalSettings.fileViewerDesc: Show task detail controls for browsing and previewing workspace files relative to a task.
instanceExperimentalSettings.firstTaskAria: Toggle first task plan proposal experimental setting
instanceExperimentalSettings.firstTaskDesc: When the user's first request is a single task, the chief of staff writes a short plan document and a checkbox card instead of a one-card confirmation. Applies to organizations created after the toggle is flipped.
instanceExperimentalSettings.firstTaskTitle: First task: propose with a plan document
instanceExperimentalSettings.githubBotsAria: Toggle GitHub review bots experimental setting
instanceExperimentalSettings.githubBotsDesc: Connect agents to GitHub with their own App identity to review pull requests and respond to issues.
instanceExperimentalSettings.githubBotsFootnote: Independent of Chat connectors. Turning this off hides setup and management; existing bots keep running. GitHub tool connections stay available.
instanceExperimentalSettings.goalsLinkAria: Toggle goals sidebar link experimental setting
instanceExperimentalSettings.goalsLinkDesc: Restore the Goals item in the main sidebar while the goals surface is being evaluated.
instanceExperimentalSettings.grokDesc: Connect an existing Grok Bot as an agent. Verify routine delivery and an authenticated reply before assigning work.
instanceExperimentalSettings.grokFootnote: Requires Assistant connections (MCP), Paperclip Runner, and authenticated public HTTPS. Usage is not reported. Turning this off blocks Grok calls and new dispatch.
instanceExperimentalSettings.internalTools: Internal tools for developing, testing, and debugging Paperclip.
instanceExperimentalSettings.isolatedDefaultAria: Toggle isolated workspaces by default experimental setting
instanceExperimentalSettings.isolatedDefaultDesc: Treat a project that has no execution workspace policy of its own as if it selected isolated workspaces, so its tasks get a per-task worktree instead of sharing the project checkout. A project that carries its own policy keeps it.
instanceExperimentalSettings.isolatedDesc: Show execution workspace controls in project configuration and allow isolated workspace behavior for new and existing task runs.

instanceExperimentalSettings.missingCutoff: This setting is missing its activation cutoff, so no tasks run automatically.

issueChatUxLab.intro: This page exercises the real assistant-ui issue chat with fixture-backed messages. Use it to review spacing, chronology, running states, tool rendering, activity rows, queueing, and composer behavior without needing a live issue in progress.
